description: Portal-agnostic core parity checks. Every scenario is anonymous and read-only (GET or navigation only). Paths that depend on the portal are chosen from the exported portal and the local table mappings (discover.from: portal); a scenario whose candidate does not exist is reported as not applicable.
conditions: Core scenarios are anonymous: HTTP checks are cookie-free requests from the runner. Page captures use the runner's own headless browser, or with --anonymous-browser cdp an isolated context of the owned toolkit browser; the toolkit overlay serves that context with the toolkit profile's cookies, so the run refuses a profile signed in to the origin and blocks any anonymous capture that renders a signed-in portal user.

Discovered paths are chosen deterministically from the exported portal: the shallowest page anonymous visitors may not read, a stylesheet web file they may read, the first table enabled for the Web API (with its first listed column) and a mapped table with the same publisher prefix that is not enabled.

scenarios.title: Anonymous home page: status, redirect, body title, header names and cookies
Anonymous home page shell: document title, html and body attributes, script and stylesheet bundles in document order
Anonymous home page: platform client objects (Microsoft.Dynamic365.Portal, its User, Microsoft.PowerPages) by key order and value type
Anonymous request for a page anonymous visitors may not read: sign-in redirect shape and ReturnUrl encoding
The same protected page with a query string: ReturnUrl encoding of the query
Anonymous request for a URL that several exported pages share with different anonymous access: which page the portal serves
Unknown route: status and error page title
HTML response headers of the home page
Response headers and conditional GET of a public stylesheet web file
Web API read of an entity set that does not exist: status and error envelope
Anonymous Web API read of a table enabled for the Web API: status, error envelope or response shape
Anonymous Web API read of the same table without $select
Web API read of a portal configuration table
Web API read of a mapped table that is not enabled for the Web API

classifications.note: TLS and HSTS are applied by the hosting front end; the loopback runtime is plain HTTP.
Application Insights (ai.*.min.js) and Power BI embed resources are hosting and tenant services, not portal output.
Row counts depend on the records each side holds (scaffolded local data).
Mirage compatibility markers on the local document (data-sim-* attributes) are not portal output.
The home page does not render the same way: status or document shell unavailable (routing or import, D).
The document title or html/body attributes rendered by the layout templates differ (Liquid and layout, A).
The chat widget script loads only locally: the deployed site does not render the chatbot (its deployed footer and deployment-profile settings differ from the export).
Platform and page script/stylesheet bundles differ in presence or document order (platform shell, C).
Application Insights (ai.*.min.js) adds its own globals to window.Microsoft; it is hosting telemetry, not portal output.
The platform client objects differ in key presence, key order, value type or empty values (platform client object, C).
Status, redirect target shape, ReturnUrl encoding or error-page title differ (routing, D).
Page or web-file response headers differ: caching, content type, disposition, ETag or conditional GET (serving, D).
Web API status, error envelope, error code or response shape differ (B).
